products.descriptionEn: Seamless design — the art of extended space.
products.description: 无界设计，空间延伸的艺术。
products.name: 隐形门系统
products.detail:
消解边界，让空间回归纯粹秩序。

采用与墙面无缝契合的隐藏工法，将门扇与木饰面融为一体。开合自如之间，消减视觉割裂感，为居所带来流畅、静谧的流动美学与通透层次。
products.detailEn:
Dissolving boundaries, the space returns to a state of pure order.

Through a concealed installation technique that integrates seamlessly with the walls, the door panels become one with the wood-paneled surfaces. As they open and close with effortless ease, visual fragmentation is minimized—infusing the residence with a fluid, tranquil aesthetic and a sense of airy, layered openness.

products.name: 木饰面护墙
products.descriptionEn: Warm touch that defines the character of a space.
products.description: 温润触感，定义空间基调。
products.detail:
严苛微缝工法，构筑现代墙面新秩序。

采用精工挂板干挂工艺与防潮平衡结构，有效防止板材形变。极窄金属微缝收口设计，支持与隐形门、柜体及灯光无缝嵌合，细节之处尽显工艺造诣。
products.detailEn:
Rigorous micro-joint installation techniques establish a new order for modern wall surfaces.

Utilizing precision dry-hanging panel systems and moisture-resistant, balanced structural design, the method effectively prevents panel deformation. The ultra-narrow metal micro-joint detailing allows for seamless integration with concealed doors, cabinetry, and lighting—a testament to masterful craftsmanship in every detail.

products.name: 高定收纳
products.descriptionEn: The balance of rational order and sensual aesthetics.
products.description: 理性秩序与感性美学的平衡。
products.detail:
秩序与仪式感并存，收纳亦是生活的策展。

结合悬挂系统、精密皮革抽屉与智能柔光照明，重构衣物与珍藏的收纳逻辑。通过通透玻璃与质感金属的细腻对话，将日常更衣升级为私密而优雅的艺术仪式。
products.detailEn:
Where order meets a sense of ritual, storage becomes a curation of one’s life.

Integrating a suspension system, precision-crafted leather drawers, and intelligent, soft-glow lighting, this design reimagines how garments and cherished possessions are organized. Through the nuanced interplay of transparent glass and refined metal, the daily act of dressing is elevated into an intimate, elegant, and artistic ritual.

products.name: 智能中控
products.description: 科技隐于无形，服务生活。
products.detail:
指尖轻触之间，化繁为简掌控全屋场景。

采用航空级铝合金精雕机身与AG防眩光防指纹玻璃，支持嵌入式极平齐安装，与木饰面护墙浑然一体。一屏整合照明、暖通、遮阳与全屋影音，告别墙面杂乱开关，回归纯粹空间美感。
products.detailEn:
With a gentle touch, simplify the control of your entire home environment.

Crafted with a precision-milled, aerospace-grade aluminum alloy frame and an anti-glare, anti-fingerprint (AG) glass surface, the unit supports a flush, recessed installation—blending seamlessly into wood-paneled walls. A single screen integrates lighting, HVAC, shading, and whole-home audio-visual systems, eliminating the clutter of multiple wall switches and restoring the pure aesthetic beauty of your space.

news.summary: 全新整木定制系列于上海首发，融合东方美学与现代工艺，重塑人与空间的边界。
news.title: 木栖家居新品发布会：重塑边界
news.content:
2025 年 11 月，木栖家居年度新品发布会在上海举行，正式发布全新整木定制系列。

本次发布以「重塑边界」为主题，系列覆盖玄关、客厅、餐厨、卧室等全屋场景，在设计语言上延续品牌极简东方美学，同时在结构与收纳体系上完成了一次系统升级。

发布会现场，设计团队分享了从材料选型到落地工艺的全流程思考，并宣布系列产品将于全国门店陆续上线。
news.summaryEn: A brand-new whole-wood customization series debuts in Shanghai, blending Eastern aesthetics with modern craftsmanship to redefine the boundary between people and space.
news.titleEn: Muqi Home New Product Launch: Redefining Boundaries
news.contentEn:
In November 2025, Muqi Home held its annual new product launch in Shanghai, officially unveiling a brand-new whole-wood customization series.

Centered on the theme 'Redefining Boundaries', the collection covers entryways, living rooms, kitchens and bedrooms, extending the brand's minimalist Eastern aesthetic while delivering a systematic upgrade in structure and storage.

At the event, the design team shared their full journey from material selection to craftsmanship, announcing the collection would roll out across showrooms nationwide.

news.summaryEn: The 'Qi · Yin' collection wins the International Design Gold Award for its masterful interplay of wood and light.
news.titleEn: Awarded the 2024 International Design Gold Award
news.contentEn:
Muqi Home's 'Qi · Yin' collection has been awarded the 2024 International Design Gold Award.

Defined by natural wood grain and restrained lighting, the collection achieves a warm tactility within minimalist forms. The jury praised it for 'striking a rare balance between function, craftsmanship and emotion'.

This marks the third consecutive year Muqi Home has received an international design accolade, further validating the team's long-standing commitment to original design.
news.title: 荣获2024年度国际设计金奖
news.summary: 木栖家居「栖 · 隐」系列凭借对木材与光影的极致把控，摘得年度国际设计金奖。
news.content:
木栖家居「栖 · 隐」系列荣获 2024 年度国际设计金奖。

该系列以天然木纹与克制光影为核心语言，在极简形体中呈现温润质感，评审团评价其「在功能、工艺与情感之间取得了罕见的平衡」。

这是木栖家居连续第三年获得国际权威设计奖项，也是对团队长期坚持原创设计的又一次肯定。

news.summary: 我们承诺所有主材均来自可持续认证林场，从源头守护森林与未来。
news.content:
木栖家居正式发布《木材可持续发展承诺》。

我们承诺：品牌所有主材均采购自经国际认证的可持续林场，每批次木材均可溯源；生产环节优先选用环保胶黏剂与低能耗工艺，并通过边角料循环再利用减少浪费。

可持续发展不是营销话术，而是我们对待材料、对待自然的长期态度。
news.title: 关于木材可持续发展的企业承诺
news.contentEn:
Muqi Home officially releases its Wood Sustainability Commitment.

We commit to sourcing all primary materials from internationally certified sustainable forests, with full traceability for every batch; production prioritizes eco-friendly adhesives and low-energy processes, while offcuts are recycled to reduce waste.

Sustainability is not a marketing slogan - it is our long-term attitude toward materials and nature.
news.titleEn: Our Commitment to Sustainable Wood Sourcing
news.summaryEn: We commit to sourcing all primary materials from certified sustainable forests, protecting nature from the very beginning.
